sentences.text: Why do most small channels stall at a thousand subscribers?
I spent a year finding out.
The answer surprised me, and it is not the algorithm.
This video is sponsored by Brindle Coffee.
Use code GARDEN20 for twenty per cent off your first bag at brindle dot coffee slash garden.
Their beans are roasted every Monday and the link is in the description.
You only need three things: a clear promise, a steady schedule, and titles that say what is inside.
Most people get the first one wrong.
They promise everything, so nobody knows why to subscribe.
Here is the mistake I made for six months, and how I fixed it in a week.
I wrote one sentence that said who the channel was for, and I put it everywhere.
